_guide.title: OmnishPilot job import
_guide.philosophy: Keep imports short. Point the agent at skills and a workspace — let it scan the codebase, draft scripts, and produce assets. You review in the UI before anything runs.

skills.when: Marketing copy, hooks, positioning, social posts, voiceover scripts, thumbnail briefs
skills.note: Stress-test claims and write convincing, evidence-backed copy — not generic AI fluff.

skills.when: Remotion video ads / social reels / explainers
skills.note: Require Kokoro voice am_michael for all VO (not ElevenLabs).

skills.when: Built-in image generation briefs and visual direction

agentWorkflow: Set inputs.workspace to a real folder path on the server.
List skills in instructions.agentPrompt (or a dedicated skills array on the job).
Tell the agent to scan the codebase for context before writing copy or code.
For video/social jobs: use lean-venture-analyst for script + post copy; use remotion-ads for rendering with Kokoro am_michael voiceover (not ElevenLabs).
Leave instruction sections empty when the agent should generate them from inputs + skills.
_guide.docs: Full template reference: GET /api/meta — or use the in-app job wizard.

jobs.title: Draft launch post from repo context

inputs.title: Draft launch post from repo context
inputs.goal: Scan the codebase and README. Write a convincing launch post and 3 hook variants for social.

instructions.agentPrompt:
Use skills: lean-venture-analyst, content-strategy.

1. Scan the workspace (README, package.json, key docs) for facts.
2. Apply lean-venture-analyst for positioning and hooks.
3. Output result.md with post copy + hooks — no invented metrics.
instructions.constraints: Public facts only. Cite file paths you used.
